title: Requested temperature reaches text generation
summary:
Text requests got more predictable pacing, shared queues for nearby IPs, and correct temperature forwarding.

The OpenAI generation path now forwards the requested temperature, so that setting reaches the model.

Text requests are queued one at a time, with starts spaced at least three seconds apart per IP group. The separate 40-requests-per-minute limit is unchanged.

Queue grouping now uses the first three segments of an IPv4 address, so addresses with the same /24-style prefix are paced together.
